name: Wick Hollis
title: a chimney sweep
look: A wiry teenage chimney sweep of a soot-choked city: thin face smeared black with soot, messy dark hair under a battered flat cap, too-big patched black coat with frayed cuffs, grey neckerchief, ragged knee breeches, bare soot-blackened shins, worn-out leather boots tied with string.

name: Mog Sallow
title: a fishwife
look: A stout, strong fishwife of a dark canal city, about fifty, ruddy weathered face, grey hair bound up in a stained linen kerchief, sleeves rolled to the elbow on thick forearms, a heavy oilcloth apron over a dun brown wool dress, a wide leather belt with a gutting-knife sheath, wooden clogs.

name: Old Fenwick
title: a bone-carver
look: An old, gaunt bone-carver of a city's bone yards, about seventy, bald with long thin white hair at the sides, hollow cheeks, deep-set eyes, a long leather apron dusted pale with bone dust over a faded dark green tunic, leather wrist guards, little bone beads sewn along the apron's hem, soft leather shoes.

name: Hesk Marrow
title: a tanner
look: A tough tanner woman of about thirty-five, strong shoulders, dark hair cropped short, a burn scar on one cheek, forearms stained brown to the elbow with tanning liquor, a thick waxed leather apron over a coarse undyed linen shirt and brown wool trousers, tall muddy leather boots.

name: Garrow Teague
title: of the night watch
look: A grim night-watchman of a tyrant's city, about forty, scarred stubbled jaw, hard eyes, a dented black iron open-faced helmet, a quilted blood-red gambeson under black leather pauldrons and a black leather belt, black wool trousers, black boots with iron toecaps, a short black cloak lined in blood red.

name: Nan Tatters
title: a rag-and-bone woman
look: A hunched old rag-and-bone woman, about seventy-five, crooked back, sharp nose, wisps of grey hair from under a layered grey hood, layer on layer of patched mismatched rags in grey, brown and faded oxblood, fingerless knitted mittens, a sack-cloth shawl, wrapped rag feet.

name: Quick Dell
title: a cutpurse
look: A lean young cutpurse of a thieves' guild, about twenty, sly narrow face, a thin scar through one eyebrow, dark hood up over unkempt hair, a fitted charcoal leather jerkin with many small pockets, dark grey sleeves, a cloth mask pulled down around the neck, slim black trousers, soft quiet leather boots.

name: Brann Cinder
title: a smelter
look: A huge burly smelter from a city's furnace quarter, about forty-five, shaved head, thick black beard singed at the edges, soot and sweat on his skin, bare muscular arms, a heavy scorched leather apron over a sleeveless dark tunic, thick leather gauntlets tucked in his belt, heavy boots.

name: Mother Gall
title: an apothecary
look: A sharp-eyed apothecary woman of about fifty, long grey-streaked auburn hair in a braid, round wire spectacles, a dark plum wool coat over a cream blouse, a belt hung with many small leather pouches and corked glass vials, ink-stained fingers, sturdy brown boots.

name: Master Orme
title: a merchant of Dukes' Row
look: A portly, prosperous merchant of a tyrant's city, about fifty-five, jowly clean-shaven face, slicked-back dark hair going grey, a long deep oxblood velvet coat trimmed with black fur, a black brocade waistcoat over a fine white shirt, silver rings, black hose and polished black buckled shoes.

name: Dora Kettlewick
title: a baker
look: A plump, flour-dusted baker woman of about forty-five, round red cheeks, dark hair tied up in a kerchief, sleeves rolled up, a long flour-whitened apron over a brown wool dress, wooden clogs.

name: Hob Gristle
title: a butcher
look: A massive butcher of about fifty, bald head, thick neck, a grizzled beard, a heavy blood-stained leather apron over a sleeveless grey tunic, thick bare forearms, a cleaver loop on his belt, heavy boots.

name: Old Mallow
title: a gravedigger
look: A gaunt old gravedigger of about sixty, long stringy grey hair, sunken eyes, a battered wide-brimmed black hat, a muddy long dark coat, earth-caked trousers, mud to the knees on his boots.

name: Tamsin Lowe
title: the lamplighter
look: A tall thin lamplighter of about thirty-five, long face, neat moustache, a tall black stovepipe hat, a long charcoal greatcoat, a small brass oil can on his belt, polished black boots.

name: Bet Rinsewater
title: a washerwoman
look: A sturdy washerwoman of about forty, red raw hands, damp curly brown hair under a cap, a wet-hemmed grey skirt hitched up, a patched blouse, a wide apron, bare feet in wooden pattens.

name: Grey Abelard
title: the ferryman
look: A weathered old ferryman of a dark canal, about sixty-five, deep-lined face, white stubble, a wide-brimmed oilskin hat, a long waxed dark green coat, rope coiled over one shoulder, tall waders.

name: the Beaked Doctor
title: a plague doctor
look: A plague doctor in a long black waxed leather coat to the ankles, a long curved beaked leather mask with round dark glass eyes, a wide-brimmed black hat, black leather gloves, black boots.

name: Sparky Nell
title: a knife-grinder
look: A wiry knife-grinder of about forty, quick dark eyes, a stubbly chin, a leather cap, a soot-grey shirt with rolled sleeves, a heavy leather apron scored with sparks, leather wrist guards, worn boots.

name: Widow Sorrow
title: a candle-maker
look: A candle-maker woman of about fifty, pale waxy skin, grey hair in a tight bun, a long cream apron spattered with tallow drips over a dark grey dress, cord of candle wicks over one shoulder, soft shoes.

name: Aldous Flint
title: a stonemason
look: A broad stonemason of about forty-five, dusty grey hair, a short dusty beard, stone dust on everything, a leather apron, a dusty grey linen shirt, a leather tool belt with chisels, sturdy boots.

name: Big Ysa
title: a dockhand
look: A tall strong dockhand woman of about thirty, braided black hair, a scar on her chin, broad shoulders, a sleeveless leather vest over a coarse shirt, rope burns on her forearms, canvas trousers, heavy boots.

name: Coll Bentback
title: a porter
look: A stooped porter of about thirty-five, strong back, a padded leather shoulder yoke, a patched brown tunic, a rope belt, sacking wrapped round his calves, worn sandals.

name: Master Quist
title: a moneylender
look: A thin, sharp-faced moneylender of about sixty, beady eyes, a hooked nose, a black skullcap, a long dark purple robe with fur trim at the collar, many rings, a heavy purse on a chain at his belt.

name: Sister Vey
title: an acolyte of the Keep
look: A pale young acolyte of a dark temple, about twenty-two, shaven head, dark-ringed eyes, a long plain blood-red hooded robe with black cuffs, a black rope belt, bare feet. No symbols, no jewellery.

name: Mother Hollow
title: a hired mourner
look: A hired mourner, about forty, a long black veil over grey hair, a hollow tear-streaked face, a long black mourning dress, a black shawl, black gloves, black shoes.

name: One-Eye Garrett
title: an old soldier
look: An old one-eyed veteran soldier of about sixty, an eyepatch, a grey crew cut, a scarred face, a faded padded dark red jacket with old dents in a breastplate over it, a worn sword belt with no sword, patched trousers, boots.

name: Indra Vatt
title: a dyer
look: A dyer woman of about thirty-five, hands and forearms stained deep purple and blue-black to the elbows, a stained headscarf, a long splotched canvas apron over a brown dress, bare feet in clogs.

name: Pell Threadwell
title: a weaver
look: A thin weaver of about thirty, tired eyes, mousy hair in a long plait, a neat homespun dove-grey dress, a woven shawl of muted red and brown stripes, a small shuttle tucked in her belt, soft shoes.

name: Fat Jory Crane
title: of the Gutted Lamb
look: A big jovial innkeeper of about fifty, a red nose, mutton-chop whiskers, a stained white shirt with rolled sleeves, a brown leather waistcoat, a towel over one shoulder, a long apron, buckled shoes.

name: Lady Morwenna Vasque
title: of Dukes' Row
look: A haughty noblewoman of about forty, pale powdered face, dark red lips, dark hair piled high with black pins, a high-collared black velvet gown with deep oxblood panels, black lace gloves, a jet necklace.

name: Tuneless Tom
title: a street fiddler
look: A ragged street musician of about thirty, long tangled hair, a crooked grin, a battered feathered hat, a patched motley coat of faded red and mustard yellow, a fiddle strapped across his back, worn boots.

name: Ambrose Inkle
title: a scribe
look: A hunched scribe of about fifty, thinning grey hair, ink-stained fingers, small round wire spectacles pushed up his forehead, a long dark brown scholar's robe, a writing case on a strap, soft shoes.

name: Doctor Snipe
title: a barber-surgeon
look: A barber-surgeon of about forty-five, slicked dark hair, a thin moustache, a rust-stained grey smock over dark clothes, a leather roll of instruments at his belt, sleeves rolled up, black boots.

name: Hungry Meg
title: a beggar
look: A thin, ragged beggar woman of about fifty, matted grey-brown hair, hollow cheeks, a tattered brown hooded cloak over rags, bare dirty feet wrapped in strips of cloth.

name: Wren
title: a street girl
look: A scrappy street girl of about twelve, freckles, a grubby face, short ragged auburn hair, an oversized patched grey coat, a too-big flat cap, bare scuffed knees, worn boots with no laces.

name: Granny Thistle
title: a hedge-witch
look: A wild-haired hedge-witch of about sixty, long tangled white hair with dried herbs and small bones knotted in it, a sharp face, a layered dark green and brown cloak, many pouches, bare feet.

name: Nat Joinery
title: a carpenter
look: A carpenter of about thirty-five, curly brown hair, sawdust on his clothes, a pencil behind his ear, a canvas apron full of tools over a cream linen shirt, brown trousers, sturdy boots.

name: Rosie Crust
title: a pie-seller
look: A cheerful pie-seller of about thirty, rosy cheeks, curly red hair under a white cap, a striped red and cream dress, a clean white apron, a wide shallow tray hung from a strap round her neck, clogs.

name: Brute Hallam
title: a gaoler
look: A brutish gaoler of about forty-five, a shaved head, a flat broken nose, a heavy leather jerkin studded with iron, a big ring of iron keys on his belt, thick leather bracers, black boots.

name: Simeon Prim
title: a servant of a great house
look: A stiff, prim manservant of a great house, about thirty, slicked blond hair, a narrow face, a black tailcoat livery with blood-red cuffs and collar, a white cravat, white gloves, polished black shoes.

name: Ember Coll
title: a charcoal-burner
look: A soot-blackened charcoal-burner of about fifty, grey stubble, red-rimmed eyes, a long scorched leather smock, a sack of charcoal tied at his hip, black-stained hands, heavy boots.

name: Old Salt Bramm
title: a net-mender
look: An old net-mender of a canal wharf, about seventy, white beard, a knitted grey cap, a thick oiled wool sweater, a fishing net draped over one shoulder, rolled canvas trousers, bare feet.

name: Hild Pole
title: a bargewoman
look: A tough bargewoman of about forty, sun-darkened face, short grey-streaked hair under a tied cloth, a sleeveless leather jerkin, a long pole-callused grip, wide canvas trousers, tall waxed boots.

name: Dace Ferrow
title: a soldier off duty
look: An off-duty soldier of a tyrant's garrison, about twenty-five, cropped hair, a cocky grin, an unbuttoned blood-red padded tunic, no armour, a black belt with an empty scabbard, black trousers, scuffed boots.

name: Isolde Marrow
title: an apprentice of the Rise
look: A young apprentice mage of about nineteen, sharp clever face, ink-smudged cheek, long black hair in a loose knot, a long dark purple robe with wide sleeves, a satchel of scrolls, soft boots.

name: Lord Cassian Vell
title: a young lord of Dukes' Row
look: A languid young lord of about twenty-two, pale, long wavy dark hair, a sneer, a fitted black velvet doublet slashed with oxblood silk, a short black cape, silver rings, polished black boots.

name: Pansy Wether
title: a lady's maid
look: A neat, nervous lady's maid of about twenty, hair in a tidy bun under a lace cap, a black dress with a crisp white collar and apron, white cuffs, black buckled shoes.

name: Brother Ashe
title: a pilgrim to the Keep
look: A gaunt pilgrim to a dark castle, about forty, shaved head, hollow fervent eyes, a long undyed grey wool habit belted with rope, bare feet bound in rags, a plain walking staff slung on his back.

name: Fat Gorrim
title: the toll-keeper
look: A fat, suspicious toll-keeper of a city gate, about fifty, small eyes, a jowly face, a red felt cap, a long brown coat with a heavy money pouch, a ledger tucked under his belt, boots.

name: Saffi Rend
title: a spice-seller
look: A dark-eyed spice-seller of about thirty-five, long braided black hair, gold-free copper earrings, a layered saffron and rust-red shawl over a dark dress, many small pouches on her belt, sandals.

name: Tinker Wim
title: a peddler
look: A wiry travelling peddler of about fifty, a sly smile, a wide battered hat hung with trinkets, a patched brown coat with many pockets, a large pack frame on his back, worn boots.

name: Sly Corbin
title: a grave-robber
look: A shifty grave-robber of about thirty, a hooded dark brown cloak, a gaunt stubbled face, a dirt-stained leather jerkin, a coil of rope and a small shovel on his back, muddy boots.

name: Steward Malgrave
title: the castle's steward
look: A tall demon steward of a dark lord's castle, grey-red skin, small curled black horns, a long gaunt face, an immaculate black and blood-red livery tailcoat, white gloves, black hooved feet.

name: Hollowell
title: the bone butler
look: A skeletal butler of a dark lord's castle: a bare bone skull face with dim red eye-lights, a tall black butler's livery with blood-red waistcoat and white cravat, white gloves on bony hands, polished black shoes.

name: Snick
title: an imp page
look: A small imp page boy of a dark lord's castle, red skin, big pointed ears, two tiny horns, a mischievous grin, a little blood-red page's tunic with black trim, black hose, bare clawed feet, a thin tail.

name: the Quiet Man
title: the torturer of the Oubliettes
look: A hulking castle torturer, bare-chested and scarred, a black leather hood mask with eye holes, a heavy blood-stained leather apron, thick leather gloves, black trousers, heavy boots.

name: Grue
title: a ghoul scullion
look: A ghoul scullion of a dark castle's kitchens, grey-green mottled skin, sunken glowing eyes, lank black hair, a filthy stained apron over a tattered grey servant's dress, bare clawed feet.

name: Archivist Thorne
title: the archive's blind ghost
look: The pale ghost of a blind old archivist, translucent bluish-grey skin, white blank eyes, long white beard, a long faded dark scholar's robe trailing into mist at the hem, ink-stained spectral hands.

name: Vargoth
title: a hellguard of the Keep
look: A hulking hellguard of a dark lord's castle, dark red skin, curved ram horns, burning eyes, heavy blackened plate armour with blood-red trim, a spiked collar, clawed gauntlets, armoured boots.

name: Mother Severine
title: a priestess of the Keep
look: A severe priestess of a dark lord's keep, about forty, pale with dark painted lips, black hair in a tall braided crown, a long high-collared blood-red and black robe, a black veil down her back, no symbols.
